summary: This YAML configuration defines a CI/CD job called 'demo' that uses a Docker image to run automated tasks. It first logs into Docker Hub securely using stored credentials, then pulls a private Docker image, with a commented-out section showing how you'd run that image afterward.

explanations.4: The pipe character (|) tells YAML to treat the following lines as a multi-line string, preserving line breaks — useful for writing shell commands that span multiple lines.
explanations.5: This pipes the Docker Hub access token into the login command via stdin (the --password-stdin flag) rather than passing it as an argument, which keeps it out of the command history for security.
explanations.7: Another pipe (|) for a multi-line shell command, this time to pull (download) the Docker image from the registry.
